info.title: API.SH: HiringCafe
info.description: The HiringCafe API from API.SH: public HiringCafe data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every open role on one company's job board as HiringCafe shows it (the site's own company page), in one page; `next_page` is always null. Identify the company with `company_id` from any search result, or by `company` name (the first company in search results with exactly that name). Each job has the same fields as /hiringcafe/v1/search. Unknown names answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hiringcafe-company-jobs

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: The company name as the site shows it (`company.name` in results). Use `company_id` when several companies share a name.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: `company_id` from a search result (identifies one company's job board exactly).

parameters.name: experience_max
parameters.description: Years of experience asked, up to (0-20).

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Words that must be in the job title.

parameters.name: description_keywords
parameters.description: Words to match in the job description.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One job on HiringCafe with its full description (text and HTML) and every field of the search results (salary, experience, seniority, tools, company data, apply link), plus similar jobs. `latest=true` with search parameters returns the first matching job. Removed jobs answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hiringcafe-job

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: `requisition_id` from search or the hiringcafe.com/job/... link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: the first job of a search with the search parameters instead of `id`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Jobs on HiringCafe (hiringcafe.com, jobs read from company career sites) with the site's filters: country, workplace type, commitment, seniority, role type, minimum salary, experience, posting age, title/description/technology keywords, benefits and company, and its sorts. Each job: `id`, `requisition_id`, `title`, `url`, `core_title`, `category`, `seniority`, `role_type`, `company` (name, website, tagline, employees, founded, HQ country, industries, organization type, stock symbol, latest funding), `location`, `workplace_type`, cities/states/countries, `geo`, `commitment`, salary (currency, frequency, yearly and hourly min/max), experience years, degree requirements, `requirements_summary`, `tools`, `licenses_or_certifications`, `languages`, `visa_sponsorship`, `apply_url` (the employer's own job page), `company_id` (for /hiringcafe/v1/company/jobs),  (for /hiringcafe/v1/company/jobs), `source`, view/apply/save counts, `posted_at` and `raw`. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/hiringcafe-search

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Comma-separated company names as the site shows them, e.g. `Stripe`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO country code of the job location (default `US`): US, CA, GB, IE, AU, NZ, IN, DE, FR, NL, ES, IT, PT, BE, CH, AT, SE, NO, DK, FI, PL, CZ, RO, MX, BR, AR, CO, CL, SG, JP, KR, PH, MY, ZA, AE, IL; `any` for every country.

parameters.name: experience_max
parameters.description: Years of experience asked, up to (0-20).

parameters.name: posted_within_days
parameters.description: Posted within this many days (the site's default is about 90).

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Words that must be in the job title.

parameters.name: description_keywords
parameters.description: Words to match in the job description.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1, 40 jobs a page). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
